stem: What happens next in this passage after “Some customers liked the restaurant, but many complained about slow service.”?
options: The empty seat was no longer a bad place.
Others were about changes that still affected the city.
Tina still went, but she no longer expected perfection.
Mina still bought bottled tea sometimes, but she no longer thought slow tea was only for old people.
